recentItems.description:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Navy has reported two oil tanker explosions near the Strait of Hormuz and the port of Khabbaz. According to the IRGC Navy, one tanker struck a naval mine near Khabbaz, while the second exploded in an unauthorised area east of the Strait of Hormuz. The incidents raise fresh concerns over maritime security in the strategically important region.

recentItems.title: Denmark's New Hijab Ban! Prosecutors Barred from Wearing Headscarves In Court, Danish PM Says...
recentItems.description:
Denmark's New Hijab Ban! Prosecutors Barred from Wearing Headscarves In Court, Danish PM Says...


Denmark is tightening its rules on religious headwear, and this time, the change directly affects prosecutors appearing in court. The Danish government has introduced new guidelines that prohibit prosecutors from wearing religious headscarves during court hearings. And this comes at a time when the country is also debating whether to extend similar restrictions to schools and universities.
